description: Preview what an Offline Protocol starter would contain for an app: workflow, template, packages and file list. A dry run that writes nothing; creating the project needs the local Offline Protocol CLI.

enableMesh.description: Enable mesh SDK for React Native templates (default: true for mesh workflows / mesh templates)

enableOfflineId.description: Enable Offline ID (id-react-native) for React Native templates. Default: true for offline-social-network / offline-id-mesh-chat workflows and react-native-social; auto-switches react-native-mesh-app to react-native-social when true.

platform.description: Required when a multi-platform workflow is named without a template

workflow.description: Workflow name, e.g. local-handoff, backend-delivery or nearby-service

name: preview_scaffold
title: Preview scaffold
